: ...and from that point on, I decided it would be in the best interest of the universe if I just never encountered a live salmon again.
lines.zh: ……从那以后，我就认定：为了全宇宙着想，我这辈子最好再也别碰上活着的鲑鱼。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection2
: Which is fine! I just need to be extra careful if I ever visit the Pacific Northwest in Q4 of any given year. We have enough clown-based fatalities as-is.
lines.zh: 这也挺好的！只是以后要是去太平洋西北地区、又刚好赶上第四季度，我得格外小心。我们这儿因为小丑死的已经够多了。

lines.en: : Thank God you explained the foundation of this story in the beginning. I can only imagine how confusing it would be for someone to walk in at the tail end of it.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地你在一开始就把这故事的底子讲清楚了。不然有人半路才进来听，得多懵啊。

lines.en: : I particularly enjoyed the connections drawn between 70’s shag carpeting and aquatic mating routines. I feel as if I have learned a lot today.
lines.zh: 我尤其喜欢你把七十年代的粗毛地毯和水生动物的交配习性联系起来那一段。感觉今天真是长见识了。

lines.en: : It’s crazy to think about how carpets like that used to be a thing at all. Style today is all about being sleek and clean. I’d {i}hate{/i} having to vacuum something like that so often.
lines.zh: 真难想象那种地毯居然真的流行过。现在的风格讲究的就是简洁干净。我可{i}讨厌{/i}隔三差五就得拿吸尘器伺候那玩意儿。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection3
: Speaking of style, Ami — what’s the plan with your hair?
lines.zh: 说到风格，Ami——你的头发打算怎么办？

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection4
: Are you gonna grow it back out again and rejoin me in the OG haircut club? Otoha brought back the top-knot, so I think she’s planning on joining as well.
lines.zh: 你打算重新留长，回到我这边这个「元祖发型俱乐部」来吗？Otoha 把丸子头带回来了，我看她八成也想加入。

lines.en: : It was either that or the straight girls club Miku is starting. Which I’m pretty sure neither one of us is  allowed to join based on the fact that we have made out like a million times.
lines.zh: 要不就加入 Miku 新开的「直女俱乐部」。不过我敢肯定，就凭我们接吻过的次数，咱俩谁都没资格进。

lines.en: : Oh! Ami and I joined that and we’ve kissed before, so I don’t think the screening process is very thorough.
lines.zh: 哦！我和 Ami 都进了那个俱乐部，我们也亲过，所以我觉得审核程序没那么严格。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection5
: If it was {i}just{/i} kissing, maybe. But I’m not sure I’d be able to live with myself if I joined a straight girls club after all of the other stuff you did to me.
lines.zh: 如果{i}只是{/i}接吻，也许吧。可在你对我做过那些别的事之后还去加入直女俱乐部，我怕自己良心过不去。

lines.en: : Please explain these things now. My sexual curiosity is at an all-time high and I require assistance in determining whether or not I am attracted to female traits apart from Ami’s legs.
lines.zh: 现在就把这些事说清楚。我目前的性好奇正处于历史最高点，我需要有人帮我判断，除了 Ami 的腿之外，我到底喜不喜欢女生的其他特征。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I’m allowed. Rin’s new guard dog might show up and try to gut me if I talk about that again.
lines.zh: 我不确定我能不能说。Rin 新养的那条看门狗要是听见我又聊这个，说不定会冲出来把我开膛破肚。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection6
: Chika’s not a {i}guard dog,{/i} Otoha! She’s just...a friend! A...really {i}close{/i} friend. Who is...certainly more protective than normal lately...but still just a friend!
lines.zh: Chika 才不是{i}看门狗{/i}，Otoha！她只是……一个朋友！一个……特别{i}亲密{/i}的朋友。最近确实比平常更护着我一点……但也只是朋友而已！

lines.en: : Mhm, right. And {i}I{/i} was a good girlfriend.
lines.zh: 嗯，对。而且{i}我{/i}以前还是个好女朋友呢。

lines.en: : You were! Best I’ve ever had at least. I’d give you a solid 7/10. Guitar skills translate well to-
lines.zh: 你确实是！至少是我交过最好的。稳稳给你打个 7 分。吉他技巧在某些方面确实很通用——

lines.en: : Sorry to interrupt...whatever {i}this{/i} is, but I’m still not really sure about what to do. And I was actually wondering what you guys would suggest.
lines.zh: 抱歉打断一下……不管{i}这{/i}算什么，我还是拿不定主意。其实我是想问问你们有什么建议。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection7
: Ayane? Tsuneyo? Short hair Ami or long hair Ami? Which one’s better?
lines.zh: Ayane？Tsuneyo？短发 Ami 和长发 Ami，哪个更好？

lines.en: : I like long hair Ami. Short hair Ami is good too, but twintails are lacking proper representation now and Io’s aren’t really as impressive as yours were.
lines.zh: 我喜欢长发 Ami。短发 Ami 也不错，不过现在双马尾这边缺个像样的代表，Io 的双马尾又没你的那么惊艳。

lines.en: : Personally, I am too invested in why characters are always pictured holding food in video games but never actually {i}eating{/i} it.
lines.zh: 我个人的注意力全在另一件事上：为什么电子游戏里的角色总是拿着食物，却从不真的{i}吃{/i}下去。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection8
: Hm? Oh, this? I’ll eat it now!
lines.zh: 嗯？哦，这个啊？我现在就吃！

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}it’s no use. Perhaps it is just impossible to properly depict based on asset restrictions.
lines.zh: {i}哈……{/i}没用的。大概是受限于素材，根本没法完整表现出来吧。

lines.en: : Cast my vote for short hair. It’s nice having some competition in the princely department.
lines.zh: 我投短发一票。王子系这边有个竞争对手挺好的。

lines.en: : Plus, from what I hear, some of the girls in other classes have already started crushing on you, Ami.
lines.zh: 再说了，我听说别的班已经有女生开始迷上你了，Ami。

lines.en: : Girls in other classes don’t exist to me and your new hair makes me want to touch you, so I vote for long hair Ami again so I don’t have to feel conflicted about that anymore.
lines.zh: 对我来说别的班的女生根本不存在，而且你的新发型让我很想摸你，所以我再投一次长发 Ami，这样就不用为这个纠结了。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection9
: What about you, Futaba? Any preference? Or should I maybe try and split the difference and go for, like...medium length or something?
lines.zh: 你呢，Futaba？有偏好吗？还是说我干脆折中一下，留个……中长发之类的？

lines.en: : Futaba’s locked in right now. Don’t think you’ll be getting an answer from her.
lines.zh: Futaba 现在整个人都在状态里。你大概问不出答案的。

lines.en: : You want breakfast or anything, Futaba? I can go grab you something from the shack. Coffee, maybe?
lines.zh: 要不要吃点早餐什么的，Futaba？我可以去小摊给你带点。咖啡行吗？

lines.en: : No thank you.
lines.zh: 不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : Kay. Just make sure you eat {i}something{/i} later, alright? You skipped dinner last night too. We need all the energy we can get for D&D later.
lines.zh: 好。那等会儿记得{i}多少{/i}吃点东西，行吗？你昨晚也没吃晚饭。待会儿跑团得攒足力气才行。

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: 知道了。

lines.en: : What are you writing, Futaba? Another fantasy thing?
lines.zh: 你在写什么，Futaba？又是一篇奇幻？

lines.en: : Essay.
lines.zh: 论文。

lines.en: : Ew, homework? Now? But this is vacation.
lines.zh: 呃，作业？现在？可这是在度假啊。

lines.en: : Not homework. Looks like an essay on-
lines.zh: 不是作业。看起来是一篇关于——

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection10
: Western civilization? Why? Are you applying to colleges already?
lines.zh: 西方文明？为什么？你已经在申请大学了？

lines.en: : Please...shut up.
lines.zh: 求你……闭嘴。

lines.en: : See — the reason Otoha is so dumbfounded right now is because she’s secretly racist and hates western civilization. It was a real problem for our relationship.
lines.zh: 瞧——Otoha 现在这么懵，是因为她其实偷偷是个种族主义者，讨厌西方文明。这事以前真是我们关系里的大问题。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection11
: {i}It came up literally once!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那事真的只发生过一次！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}After you struck me! Coincidence? I think not...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而且是在你打了我之后！这是巧合吗？我可不这么认为……{/i}

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection12
: {i}PLEASE. SHUT UP.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}拜托。闭嘴。{/i}

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei. You’re up early. Good morning.
lines.zh: 哦，Sensei。你起得真早。早上好。

lines.en: : I’m not awake because I {i}want{/i} to be. Io snuck into my room again and accidentally knocked something over.
lines.zh: 我可不是因为{i}想{/i}醒才醒的。Io 又偷偷溜进我房间，还不小心碰倒了什么东西。

lines.en: : Is that a...thing she does often?
lines.zh: 她经常……这样吗？

lines.en: : It’s like that thing people say about not feeding stray animals who wander into your yard. If you do, they’ll keep coming back.
lines.zh: 就像大家说的，别喂跑到自家院子里的流浪动物。你一喂，它们就会一直来。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection13
: What’s going on over there? Was that Futaba I just heard raising her voice?
lines.zh: 那边怎么了？我刚才听见的是 Futaba 在嚷嚷吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. She was up all night writing. Came here to try and get some peace once the other girls started waking up but, lo and behold, peace is no more.
lines.zh: 嗯。她写了一整夜。其他女生陆续醒了以后，她就来这儿想图个清静，结果你瞧，清静没了。

lines.en: : Knowing that makes it sound like you were up all night as well.
lines.zh: 听你这么说，好像你也是一整晚没睡。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection14

: {size=-1}I was! Which means I am also very tired. But fortunately, I should be able to ride a caffeine wave for the rest of the day. {i}And{/i} I got a lot done. So I’d say it was an excellent use of my infinite time.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}我确实是！也就是说我也很累。不过好在我应该能靠咖啡因撑过剩下这一天。{i}而且{/i}我还干成了不少事。所以我得说，我那无限的时间用得相当值。{/size}

lines.en: : A lot done in regard to...what, exactly?
lines.zh: 干成了不少……具体是关于什么的？

lines.en: : {size=-1}Reset stuff. I think I’ve found a way to make the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad’s activities a lot more exciting and fun so we’re not just standing around waiting for something to happen all the time.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}重置相关的事。我觉得我找到了一个办法，能让「天台末日小队」的活动变得更刺激更有趣，这样我们就不用老是干站着等事情发生了。{/size}

lines.en: : I’m gonna talk to Maya and Yumi about it later. Tsuneyo and Nodoka too, but both of them have been acting kind of...off.
lines.zh: 我待会儿要去找 Maya 和 Yumi 谈谈。Tsuneyo 和 Nodoka 也要，不过她俩最近都有点……怪怪的。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection15
: Really? Tsuneyo looks fine to me. Perhaps...{i}too{/i} fine. Is Imani really letting her wear that?
lines.zh: 是吗？我看 Tsuneyo 挺好的。也许……是{i}太{/i}好了。Imani 真就由着她穿成那样？

lines.en: : Miss Imai’s been drooling over her just as much as you have. Just {i}she{/i} has the tact to not say anything out loud.
lines.zh: Imai 老师对着她流的口水不比你少。只不过{i}她{/i}有分寸，不会说出口。

lines.en: : She has more underboob than you have regular boob.
lines.zh: 她露出来的下乳都比你的整个胸大。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection16
: Okay. Well, {i}that{/i} was just unnecessary.
lines.zh: 好吧。{i}那句话{/i}真是多余的。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection17
: So, Otoha! How’s my little Sana getting along in the light music club? She’s not causing you guys any problems, is she?
lines.zh: 对了，Otoha！我家小 Sana 在轻音社混得怎么样？她没给你们添什么麻烦吧？

lines.en: : Honestly? She’s not bad at all. She has some issues with the bass pedal, but her timing is solid and Rika’s been working pretty closely with her after school most days.
lines.zh: 说实话？她一点都不差。贝斯踏板那块还不太行，但节奏感很稳，Rika 放学后大多数日子都在手把手带她。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection18
: We’re still just in the {i}covers{/i} phase right now since we haven’t been able to decide on a direction for the band. But I think we might actually be able to start working on an original soon.
lines.zh: 我们现在还只能{i}翻唱{/i}，因为乐队的方向一直定不下来。不过我觉得应该很快就能开始做原创了。

lines.en: : Thankfully, I’ve got like a million banked already. Just have to find the right one, you know? Like there’s this one that goes-
lines.zh: 还好，我手里已经攒了差不多一百万首。只要挑到合适的就行，你懂吧？比如有这么一首，是这么走的——

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection19
: {i}Hey. You good?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}喂。你还好吗？{/i}

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: 不好。

lines.en: : {i}Wanna go back to the room? Maybe somewhere quieter? I know you’re trying to work.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}想回房间去吗？或者找个更安静的地方？我知道你在赶稿。{/i}

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection20
: Yeah. I’d be much happier failing where no one can watch me. Great fucking idea, Rin. Why didn’t I think of that?
lines.zh: 好啊。至少没人看着的时候我写砸了会开心点。真他妈是个好主意，Rin。我怎么就没想到呢？

lines.en: : Huh? I just-
lines.zh: 哈？我只是——

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection21
: Just shut the fuck up and stop checking on me every five minutes! No wonder Otoha hit you when you did the same fucking thing to her!
lines.zh: 给我他妈闭嘴，别他妈每隔五分钟就来查一次岗！你对 Otoha 干过一模一样的事，怪不得她会打你！

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection22
: Woah! Where did {i}that{/i} come from? That’s not like you, Futaba.
lines.zh: 哇哦！{i}这{/i}是怎么了？这不像你啊，Futaba。

lines.en: : Oh, what? So {i}they{/i} can joke about it? But when {i}I{/i} do it, it’s a fucking problem?! Fuck you too, Ayane! Why don’t you mind your own fucking business?!
lines.zh: 哦，怎么？{i}他们{/i}拿这事开玩笑就行，换{i}我{/i}来就成了他妈的问题？！去你的，Ayane！你他妈管好你自己不行吗？！

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection23
: ...What?
lines.zh: ……什么？

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection24
: Uhh...
: You didn’t...hear what started this, did you? Because I feel like I stopped paying attention for literally five seconds and now {i}this{/i} is happening.
lines.zh: 你没听见……是怎么起的头吧？我感觉自己就真的走神了五秒钟，结果现在就{i}这样{/i}了。

lines.en: : No...I have no clue.
lines.zh: 没……我完全不知道。

lines.en: : I...feel like we should probably do something, though.
lines.zh: 不过我……觉得我们大概得做点什么。

lines.en: : Not {i}me.{/i} I’m running on zero hours of sleep and am not particularly well-loved among peers. This has “you” written all over it.
lines.zh: 别找{i}我{/i}。我现在是零睡眠硬撑，而且在同龄人里人缘也不怎么样。这事明摆着该「你」上。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection25
: Just give me some fucking space! It’s infuriating enough that I have to {i}look{/i} at all of you all weekend! But being {i}pitied{/i} as well?! Just let me fucking work!
lines.zh: 给我他妈一点空间！整个周末都得{i}看着{/i}你们就已经够让我火大了！还要被你们{i}可怜{/i}？！让我他妈的好好写东西行不行！

lines.en: : I came over here to get away from {i}you!{/i} Remember?! I swear, it’s like all of you exist just to fucking distract me and make my life harder! Just go the fuck away!
lines.zh: 我来这边就是为了躲开{i}你们{/i}！记得吗？！我发誓，你们这群人简直就是为了他妈的让我分心、让我日子更难过才存在的！给我他妈滚远点！

lines.en: : I was just trying to-
lines.zh: 我只是想——

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection26
: {i}Oh, waaaaaah! I was just trying to help! Oh, woe is me! I have everything a girl could ever need and don’t understand what it’s like to actually suffer!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哦，呜——哇！我只是想帮忙嘛！哦，我好可怜啊！一个女孩想要的东西我应有尽有，根本不懂真正的痛苦是什么滋味！{/i}

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection27
: Just fucking {i}shut up{/i} already! Oh, and stop reminding me to eat as well! Because Sana skipped dinner too and I don’t see you fucking micro-managing {i}her!{/i}
lines.zh: 你他妈给我{i}闭嘴{/i}！哦，还有，别他妈再提醒我吃饭了！Sana 也没吃晚饭，我怎么没见你他妈这么盯着{i}她{/i}！

lines.en: : Futaba...I know what’s it’s like to-
lines.zh: Futaba……我知道那种感觉——

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection28
: You don’t know {i}shit!{/i}
lines.zh: 你{i}懂个屁{/i}！

lines.en: : You’re a fucking prodigy who can write anything she wants {i}whenever{/i} the fuck she wants — with loving parents and a home to return to!
lines.zh: 你这个该死的天才，想写什么就写什么，{i}什么时候{/i}想写就什么时候写——还有疼你的父母、有家可回！

lines.en: : You think {i}you{/i} understand what I’m going through just because you {i}also{/i} get interrupted sometimes?! Get lost! Go back to your side of the city and stop acting like you belong here!
lines.zh: 就因为你{i}偶尔{/i}也会被人在旁边烦几下，就觉得{i}你{/i}懂我在经历什么？！滚吧！回你那一半城市去，别摆出一副你属于这儿的样子！

lines.en: : Otoha, she doesn’t mean that. Sensei! Can you come here, please?!
lines.zh: Otoha，她不是那个意思。Sensei！你能过来一下吗？！

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection29
: Oh, woooow! Ayane’s calling over {i}Sensei{/i} again! What a crazy twist! I haven’t seen her try to get his attention since, what...yesterday? It’s a new fucking record!
lines.zh: 哦，哇——哦！Ayane 又在喊{i}Sensei{/i}了！这反转可真够惊人的！我上次见她想引起他注意是什么时候来着……昨天？这可真是破了他妈的新纪录！

lines.en: : Perhaps I am lacking context here, but I do not understand the cause for such fury from someone who is so typically mind-mannered.
lines.zh: 也许我缺少前情提要，但我不明白一个平时这么温顺的人，为什么会发这么大的火。

lines.en: : Yeah, well you don’t fucking understand {i}anything{/i} because you somehow have even less personality than {i}me!{/i}
lines.zh: 是啊，你他妈{i}什么都{/i}不懂，因为你的性格居然比{i}我{/i}还少！

lines.en: : Like, if it wasn’t for riding fucking Molly’s coattails all day, who would you even be? What would you like? Noodles? Awesome. Good for you! How FUCKING interesting!
lines.zh: 就说吧，要不是整天抱着 Molly 的大腿蹭，你算个什么东西？你会喜欢什么？面条？真棒。恭喜你啊！真他妈有意思！

lines.en: : I am confused. It sounds as if I am supposed to be insulted by this. But I merely just feel seen.
lines.zh: 我有点困惑。听起来我好像应该为此感到被冒犯。可我只是觉得被人看见了。

lines.en: : BECAUSE YOU’RE A FUCKING MORON! YOU’RE ALL FUCKING MORONS! EVERY ONE OF YOU! AND I CAN’T FUCKING STAND IT ANYMORE! THIS PLACE ISN’T REAL! NONE OF YOU ARE REAL!
lines.zh: 因为你就是个傻逼！你们全他妈是傻逼！一个不落！我他妈再也受不了了！这地方根本不是真的！你们没有一个是真的！

lines.en: : Futaba! Where are you going?!
lines.zh: Futaba！你要去哪儿？！

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection30
: I was just about to ask the same thing. Stop.
lines.zh: 我正想问同样的话。站住。

lines.en: : Get the fuck out of my way! If you’re looking for someone to suck you off, there’s a whole table full of girls twenty feet away practically begging to! Talk to {i}them{/i} instead!
lines.zh: 给我他妈让开！你要是想找人给你口，二十英尺外有一整桌女生求之不得呢！去跟{i}她们{/i}说啊！

lines.en: : I don’t {i}want{/i} to talk to them. I want to talk to {i}you.{/i} I need to know what’s going on.
lines.zh: 我{i}不想{/i}跟她们说。我想跟{i}你{/i}说。我得知道到底怎么回事。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection31
: Why?! So you can pretend to fucking give a shit again?! Because every time you’ve “helped” me with anything, it was always just to {i}get{/i} something!

lines.zh: 而你他妈确实{i}得到{/i}了，Sensei！多到我现在得用{i}三根{/i}手指才能让自己高潮！我还在上高中！你知道我什么感受吗？！

lines.en: : Do you know how fucking shameful it’s going to feel when you ultimately leave me and I have to explain to the {i}next{/i} guy I’m with that his dick is too small to make me feel anything?!

lines.en: : And don’t hit me with some fucking bullshit line like, “Oh, Futaba! I won’t leave you,” either! Because despite having fucked me a {i}thousand{/i} times, you still won’t even say you {i}love{/i} me!

lines.en: : What do I have to do to become more than a convenient fucking cock-sleeve to satisfy the pathetic, adolescent desires you should have grown out of a fucking decade ago?!
lines.zh: 我到底要怎么做，才能不只是个方便的鸡巴套子，用来满足你那早该在十年前就戒掉的可悲青春期欲望？！

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection33
: Because I can’t do {i}that!{/i} And I can’t {i}write!{/i} I’m not good at sports! I’m not particularly smart! So what the fuck do I have to offer?! What makes {i}me{/i} special?!
lines.zh: 因为{i}那{/i}我做不到！我{i}写{/i}也写不出来！运动我不行！我也不怎么聪明！那我他妈还有什么拿得出手的？！{i}我{/i}到底有什么特别的？！

lines.en: : No fucking wonder nobody’s acknowledging any of my contest submissions! They’re probably flagged as fucking spam the moment I send them!
lines.zh: 怪不得我投稿的比赛一个回音都没有！搞不好我一发过去就被当成垃圾邮件了！

lines.en: : It’s just hopeless to try! So why even bother?!
lines.zh: 试也是白试！那还费那个劲干嘛？！

lines.en: : Why not just throw myself into the fucking ocean and never come out?! Because I suck at swimming too! At least I’d make a good meal for a fucking shark!
lines.zh: 干脆他妈跳进海里别出来了？！反正我游泳也烂得要死！至少还能给鲨鱼当顿好饭！

lines.en: : Futaba, please. You’re scaring me.
lines.zh: Futaba，求你了。你吓到我了。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection34
: Then that’s just more proof that something is wrong here.
lines.zh: 那恰恰更能证明这里出了问题。

lines.en: : Because if you’re scared of {i}me...{/i}and not scared of {i}him,{/i} that’s just bad writing.
lines.zh: 因为如果你怕的是{i}我……{/i}却不怕{i}他{/i}，那只能说是写得烂。

lines.en: : Think of the readers, Rin. Think of how it looks to have {i}me{/i} be the bad guy while the lecherous schoolgirl-fucking “hero” swoops in to save the day. The message is lost.
lines.zh: 替读者想想，Rin。想想看，让{i}我{/i}当反派，让那个专睡女学生的好色「英雄」来救场，这算什么样子。这故事要表达的东西全没了。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection35
: We are {i}all{/i} lost. And it is {i}your{/i} fault. {i}You{/i} did this.
lines.zh: 我们{i}全都{/i}迷路了。而这是{i}你{/i}的错。是{i}你{/i}干的好事。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} broke the world.
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}把这个世界弄坏了。

lines.en: : And now you’re gonna try and pick up the pieces? Don’t make me laugh.
lines.zh: 现在你还想把碎片捡起来？别逗我笑了。

lines.en: : I hope you fucking choke on the next tongue unfortunate enough to slither into your mouth.
lines.zh: 我希望下一根倒霉地滑进你嘴里的舌头能把你活活噎死。

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection36
: Jesus fucking Christ, Futaba! What the hell has gotten into you?!
lines.zh: 我操，Futaba！你他妈到底怎么了？！

lines.en: : Woah...
lines.zh: 哇哦……

lines.en: : That was-
lines.zh: 刚才那是——

lines.en: scene futababeachinfection37
: That was nothing. Forget literally all of that. Something’s clearly wrong and I need to go chase after her to find out what.
lines.zh: 那什么都不是。那些话全都给我忘了。显然出了点事，我得去追她问清楚。

lines.en: : She gets like this when she...well, she...gets like this sometimes. But I could have sworn that-
lines.zh: 她有时候会这样……嗯，她……偶尔会这样。可我明明记得——

lines.en: : I don’t think this is...a regular sort of problem, Rin. I can’t imagine it’s something you’ve dealt with before.
lines.zh: 我觉得这……不是一般的状况，Rin。我想你应该没遇到过这种事。

lines.en: : Yeah, well I don’t exactly have the luxury to think about that right now. I’ll talk to you later, Sensei.
lines.zh: 是吗，我现在可没那个闲工夫去想。回头再聊，Sensei。

lines.en: : And...don’t take any of that too personally, please. She doesn’t actually feel that way.
lines.zh: 还有……那些话你别太往心里去，拜托。她其实不是那么想的。

lines.en: scene black
: Right...
But while she might not, some will. Some {i}do.{/i}
lines.zh: 不过就算她不是那么想，也有人会。有些人{i}就是{/i}。

lines.en: And so I shout into the void I so routinely dump the rest of my thoughts into, seeking an answer as to why they’ve wrapped their tendrils around {i}her{/i} of all people.
lines.zh: 于是我冲着那片虚空大喊——我平时就是往那里倾倒剩下的念头的——想弄明白为什么偏偏是{i}她{/i}被那些触手缠上。

lines.en: But I shout that without realizing she is far from the first — and that countless others may have already been pulled into the abyss.
lines.zh: 可我喊出这句话时并不知道，她远不是第一个——还有无数人可能早已被拖进了深渊。

lines.en: If you spend long enough in there, you won’t realize how wrong everything is.
lines.zh: 在那里面待得够久，你就不会察觉一切有多不对劲。

lines.en: Maybe I {i}did{/i} break the world if that’s the case.
lines.zh: 如果真是这样，也许我{i}确实{/i}把这个世界弄坏了。

lines.en: The only questions then becomes...
